name: Emily Spurling
reason: Re-checked under the 12 Nov rule (karmabeing.com, 12 Nov 2026): her home and about pages present her first as a '40+ Fat Loss, Strength & Nervous System Mentor' selling the Calm, Strong & Lean Method (meal plans, fat-loss timelines, strength training), a diet and fitness programme that is always out. What remains are two wellness holidays she hosts (Sri Lanka 'Flow. Feast. Pamper.', 24 Nov to 2 Dec 2026, and Thailand Rejuvenation Retreat, 20 to 27 June 2027) built around spa treatments, food and excursions with daily yoga, meditation and breathwork as one part, plus corporate wellbeing. Two spa-led retreats are too little spiritual or contemplative teaching for a listing; the owner may disagree, as she is also a yoga and mindfulness teacher whose teaching has appeared on Gaia and DailyOM.
